dependencies: Use existing /lsiopy/bin/python3. Captures five live-observed databases independently with SQLite online backup, not a cross-database transaction.
Library is local PVC /config/calibre-library mounted again at /calibre-library, NOT the NAS Books library. /cwa-book-ingest is NFS Books/ingest.
CWA, cwa-bdl and Chaptarr have writable ingest/Books access; Grimmory has writable parent Books. Read-only submounts on other arrs do not by themselves prove no parent-path writer.

Pair per-DB copies with library file bytes from the immutable CSI clone and an independently retained NAS ingest point. Require accepted DB/file/ingest skew and reconciliation for moves or deletions. No global writer fence.
Do not make CWA shared Books qualification a dependency of independent Tunarr or Victoria rollouts.
shared_integration_requirements: Provision dedicated per-app NAS and R2 Kopiur credentials in 1Password and ExternalSecrets; no existing scoped Repository was found. Do not reuse volsync-template or another app credential.
Parent must extend shared mover deadline selectors for capture, replication, verify, maintenance and discovery; retain strict read errors.

Parent must wire reviewed helpers without PodTemplate changes, qualify native NAS and exact-lineage R2 restores, then enable one daily schedule and retire VolSync separately. No legacy histories may be deleted.
